title: Granola feature list
description: A long, calm feature list on white: a serif eyebrow, a huge two-line serif headline and an ink pill, then rows each opened by a full-width hairline, with a serif title on the left, a paragraph on the right and a wide 4px-cornered picture below (one across the width, or a wide and a narrow side by side). Optional ink pill per row.
notes: a wider frame than the other blocks (page width + 80px), like the original
media are slots at 1280:527 (split about 2:1); empty, plain muted or lime-wash surfaces
static: the original shows no motion here
